Have called around to ever gas grill repair shop—all say they won’t do Weber grills bcs Weber won’t authorize them. Impossible situation. So frustrated. No asking Weber to cover the damage. Results.ReviewText: The gill is a great value and quality.  It was relatively simple to put together. We were a little suspect of the tank being held on the right side but don't mind it.  We did buy a cover for the tank separately.  This is the first grill we've purchased with an open bottom.  Again, we don't mind it and think it will be easier to clean.  We don't need all the burners on the sides so this three-burner gill is great.  We've cooked three meals on it so far. The temperature was even across the three. We are pleased.  The only bad part was getting it dirty.  That was painful but necessary.

Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
